# BusyBox commands available on Asuswrt-Merlin 3004.388 (BusyBox 1.25.1), one per line.
# From release/src/router/busybox/config_base plus the build edits every Merlin model gets
# (release/src-rt/Makefile BusyboxOptions: FLOCK, SPLIT, UNIQ, SEQ, LSOF, XXD on).
# Left out on purpose: sha256sum (only on BCM6756/BCM4916 builds). [, test, printf and echo are
# separate programs on Merlin (no ash builtins), and .github/tests/large-history.sh runs them that way.
# That test runs the script with only these commands (and stand-ins for nvram and wl) on PATH.
